questions.question: My landlord locked me out of my flat yesterday. Should I sue him?

result.query: My landlord locked me out of my flat yesterday. Should I sue him?
result.text:
One of our lawyers can help with this.

If your flat is in Lagos State and governed by the Tenancy Law of Lagos State 2011, the law sets rules on how a landlord may lawfully recover possession. A notice to quit ends the tenancy but does not give the landlord the right to lock you out. If you stayed after the notice expired, the landlord must serve a written notice of intention to recover possession giving at least seven days, and only after that can the landlord apply to court.

However, I cannot advise you on whether you should sue, assess your chances, or recommend what you should do. Please send an enquiry using the "Talk to a lawyer" button below, and one of our lawyers can review what happened and advise you.
